items.question: In what threefold form does the speaker worship the goddess honored by the three worlds?
premises: The goddess is saluted by the three worlds.
The goddess is characterized as having a threefold form.
The speaker personally performs worship of this goddess.
items.inference: The speaker's worship is directed to a universally revered goddess manifesting in a threefold form.
uncertainties: devīn is morphologically plural but may refer to a single goddess in honorific or contextual usage.
trimūrttim may allude to a specific triadic manifestation not explicitly identified in this verse.
items.plain_english: I worship the goddess, honored by the three worlds, in her threefold form.
